info.title: fullsend
info.summary: An email API that is compatible with Resend.
info.description: The public API of fullsend. The paths, the request bodies, the responses and the error names follow Resend. Send an API key as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. fullsend does not serve this file: it is in the repository.

host.description: The API hostname of your deploy.

post.description: Accepts a full access key or a sending key.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of 1 to 256 characters. A repeat of the same request with the same key returns the first result. The same key with a different body gives 409.

requestBody.description: The email. fullsend does not support `template`.

from.description: The sender, as `email@example.com` or `Name <email@example.com>`. The domain must be verified.

text.description: The plain text body. Send `html` or `text`.

scheduled_at.description: An ISO 8601 time or natural language (for example `in 1 hour`). At most 30 days from now.

get.description: Newest first. Needs a full access key.

post.description: A batch email has no `attachments` and no `scheduled_at`.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A key of 1 to 256 characters. A repeat of the same request with the same key returns the first result. The same key with a different body gives 409.

parameters.name: x-batch-validation
parameters.description: `strict` (default): one invalid email fails the batch. `permissive`: fullsend sends the valid emails and lists the others in `errors`.

from.description: The sender, as `email@example.com` or `Name <email@example.com>`. The domain must be verified.

text.description: The plain text body. Send `html` or `text`.

get.description: Counts the email events in UTC. A rate is a percent from 0 to 100, with one decimal.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: A date or a date and time. Default: 6 days before `end_date`.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: A date or a date and time. A date alone includes the whole day.

parameters.name: dimensions
parameters.description: A comma separated list or a repeated parameter. Allowed: `period`, `domain` and `email`.

parameters.name: metrics
parameters.description: A comma separated list or a repeated parameter. Allowed: sent, delivered, complained, suppressed, bounced, bounced_transient, bounced_permanent, bounced_undetermined, opened, clicked, delivery_delayed, failed, unique_opened, unique_clicked, delivery_rate, open_rate, click_rate, bounce_rate, complaint_rate.

parameters.name: domain_id
parameters.description: A comma separated list or a repeated parameter of domain ids.

parameters.name: email_id
parameters.description: A comma separated list or a repeated parameter of email ids.

patch.summary: Change the send time of a scheduled email

scheduled_at.description: An ISO 8601 time or natural language.

get.summary: List the attachments of an email

parameters.name: expires
parameters.description: The expiry time in epoch milliseconds.

get.description: The signed link needs no API key. It expires after one hour.

post.description: The domain must be in an active zone of the Cloudflare account.

region.description: Only the default region is accepted.

custom_return_path.description: Cloudflare sets the return path. fullsend refuses another value.

capabilities.description: fullsend always sends and never receives. It refuses another value.

get.summary: Get a domain with its DNS records

patch.summary: Change the tracking of a domain

post.summary: Check the DNS records of a domain

domain_id.description: Limits a sending key to one domain.

token.description: The key. fullsend shows it one time.

get.summary: List the events that fullsend sent to an endpoint
Get an event with its payload
List the delivery attempts of an event

parameters.name: idOrEmail
parameters.description: The suppression id or the address.

get.summary: List the requests to the Resend routes
get.description: fullsend stores no request body and no User-Agent.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The email id. A `.gif` or `.png` suffix is allowed.

bearerAuth.description: A fullsend API key. A sending key can call only `POST /emails` and `POST /emails/batch`.

limit.name: limit
limit.description: The page size, from 1 to 100. Default: 20.

after.name: after
after.description: A cursor id. Returns the items after it. Do not use with `before`.

before.name: before
before.description: A cursor id. Returns the items before it. Do not use with `after`.

Error400.description: The idempotency key is not valid.

example.name: invalid_idempotency_key
example.message: The key must be between 1-256 chars.

Error401.description: The API key is missing, or it has no access to the route.

example.name: missing_api_key
example.message: Missing API key in the authorization header.

Error403.description: The API key is not valid, or the link is not valid.

Error409.description: The idempotency key is in use.

example.name: invalid_idempotent_request
example.message: This idempotency key has been used on a request with a different payload.

Error429.description: The rate limit of the key is reached.

filename.description: Needed with `content`. With `path`, the default is the end of the URL.

path.description: An http or https URL that fullsend fetches (10 files at most).

AttachmentInput.description: Set `content` or `path`. The email is 5 MiB or less in total.

Attachment.description: In a list, an item has no `object`.

items.description: One row. A count is a number. `period`, `domain` and `email` are text.

payload.description: The JSON body that fullsend sent.

http_status_code.description: 0 when the request did not get a response.

Suppression.description: In a list, an item has no `object`.

response_body.description: The error body of a failed request, else null.
